<script>
(function() {
  // Before & After Slider Label Visibility Control
  function initBeforeAfterLabels() {
    // Find the before-after section and its elements
    const beforeAfterSection = document.querySelector('[data-section-type="before-after"]');
    if (!beforeAfterSection) return;

    // Get the range input slider
    const slider = beforeAfterSection.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    if (!slider) return;

    // Get the before and after labels
    const beforeLabel = beforeAfterSection.querySelector('[data-label="before"]');
    const afterLabel = beforeAfterSection.querySelector('[data-label="after"]');

    if (!beforeLabel || !afterLabel) return;

    // Add CSS transitions for smooth opacity changes
    beforeLabel.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-in-out';
    afterLabel.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-in-out';

    // Function to update label visibility based on slider position
    function updateLabelVisibility() {
      const sliderValue = parseInt(slider.value);
      const sliderMax = parseInt(slider.max) || 100;
      const percentage = (sliderValue / sliderMax) * 100;

      // Hide "After" label when slider > 70%
      if (percentage > 70) {
        afterLabel.style.opacity = '0';
        afterLabel.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      } else {
        afterLabel.style.opacity = '1';
        afterLabel.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
      }

      // Hide "Before" label when slider < 30%
      if (percentage < 30) {
        beforeLabel.style.opacity = '0';
        beforeLabel.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      } else {
        beforeLabel.style.opacity = '1';
        beforeLabel.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
      }
    }

    // Listen to slider input events
    slider.addEventListener('input', updateLabelVisibility);
    slider.addEventListener('change', updateLabelVisibility);

    // Run on initial page load
    updateLabelVisibility();
  }

  // Initialize when DOM is ready
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBeforeAfterLabels);
  } else {
    initBeforeAfterLabels();
  }

  // Also reinitialize on Shopify section reload (for theme editor)
  document.addEventListener('shopify:section:load', initBeforeAfterLabels);
})()
</script>

<style>
/* Ensure labels have smooth transitions */
[data-label="before"],
[data-label="after"] {
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in-out;
}
</style>
